entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Steps 1-5 complete: LootAlertListener now subscribes to NpcLootReceived/PlayerLootReceived/LootReceived (filtered EVENT|PICKPOCKET) and independently checks the value-threshold and mega-rare-allowlist rules per item, firing to one or both channels. AccomplishmentLootListener.java deleted, CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java registration updated. ./gradlew compileJava succeeded.
entries.detail: TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS now holds 7 entries (the original 4 plus MOKHAIOTL_CLOTH, EYE_OF_AYAK_UNCHARGED, AVERNIC_TREADS). handleLoot() runs both checks independently per item rather than early-returning, so an item can trigger both AlertKind.LOOT and AlertKind.ACCOMPLISHMENT.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Caught and fixed a self-introduced regex bug in PetDropListener's PET_OBTAINED pattern before it was ever run - a malformed alternation would have matched "funny feeling like you would have been being followed" (duplicated "been being") instead of the correct wording.
entries.detail: First draft of the edit combined the phrase variants into a single broken group-alternation; rewritten as three clean literal alternatives (funny feeling like you're being followed | funny feeling like you would have been followed | feel something weird sneaking into your backpack) matching the reference plugin exactly. Caught by re-reading the edit immediately after applying it, before compiling.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Discovered a pre-existing compiler deprecation warning on LootAlertListener.java after Step 5's compile - net.runelite.api.ItemID (used by all 7 TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS entries) is a deprecated class, superseded by net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID.
entries.detail: Isolated via a standalone javac -Xlint:deprecation test referencing all 8 original+new constants - confirmed it's a class-level deprecation ("ItemID in net.runelite.api has been deprecated") affecting every constant equally, not specific to the 3 new Mokhaiotl items. Pre-existing - the same warning already existed on the now-deleted AccomplishmentLootListener.java, just never surfaced/documented. Not migrating to the gameval class in this task (out of scope, needs each constant re-verified for an exact name match) - logged as new concern WRN-008 instead.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Steps 6-8 complete: PetDropListener and OneTimeRewardListener both now filter to ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE before matching chat text, closing the spoofing gap. concerns.json updated - WRN-006 marked resolved (spoofing half), new WRN-007 (OneTimeRewardListener wording still unconfirmed) and WRN-008 (deprecated ItemID) added. ./gradlew compileJava succeeded after all changes.
entries.detail: PetDropListener's PET_OBTAINED pattern also gained a third confirmed variant ("funny feeling like you would have been followed", the duplicate-pet-roll wording) sourced from the discord-notifications reference plugin.

entries.author: system
entries.detail: Definition of done, concerns check, and worklog review confirmed. Dev UAT accepted on compile + two live client boots plus code-review-level confidence, since the real game-content triggers (Mokhaiotl chest reward, pet drop, cape completion) can't be reproduced in a dev environment - same bar every prior game-event-driven task in this repo has shipped on.
